title: FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover — Trigger Verification, Payment and Dispute Standards
content:
These are the claims-side service standards of FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines): how a trigger reading is treated before payment, how quickly and to whom a payout is made, and the time limits that follow a payout decision. The values are set per tier in the table below.

| Setting | FloodPay Home 5K | FloodPay Home 10K | FloodPay Home 25K | FloodPay Business 50K | FloodPay Business 100K | FloodPay Business 250K |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Waiting period after sensor activation before a reading can trigger a payout (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Trigger reading must be verified against the sensor's health log before payout | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Readings from a moved or tampered sensor are void | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Tidemark confirms a trigger to the policyholder within (elapsed hours) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Payout issued within, after a verified trigger (business days) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Who receives payouts | Policyholder | Policyholder | Policyholder | Policyholder | Policyholder | Policyholder |
| How payouts are made | ACH | ACH | ACH | ACH | ACH | ACH |
| Days after a payout decision within which the policyholder may dispute the reading (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Disputed reading checked against the nearest USGS stream gauge or NOAA tide gauge record | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Months after a payout decision within which suit may be filed (calendar months) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Years sensor readings are retained | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |

## Settings in words

- **Waiting period** — 10 calendar days after sensor activation on every tier, before which a reading cannot trigger a payout.
- **Reading verification** — on every tier a trigger reading must be verified against the sensor's health log before payout.
- **Tamper exclusion** — on every tier, readings from a moved or tampered sensor are void.
- **Trigger confirmation** — Tidemark confirms a trigger to the policyholder within 24 elapsed hours.
- **Payout timing** — the payout is issued within 3 business days after a verified trigger.
- **Payee and method** — payouts go to the policyholder, by ACH.
- **Dispute window** — the policyholder may dispute the reading within 30 calendar days after a payout decision, and a disputed reading is checked against the nearest USGS stream gauge or NOAA tide gauge record.
- **Suit limitation** — suit may be filed within 24 calendar months after a payout decision.
- **Data retention** — sensor readings are retained for 7 years.

## Points of reference

- The time units differ from row to row and are part of each setting: the waiting period and the dispute window count calendar days, payout timing counts business days, trigger confirmation counts elapsed hours, and the suit limitation counts calendar months.
- None of these settings varies by tier; the same figures apply to the FloodPay Home and FloodPay Business tiers alike.
